components_instructions.marketing: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing grids (Tetris layout). Implement bento blocks with generous padding and asymmetry.
components_instructions.dashboard: Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Tables, Modals, Forms). Override default Shadcn rounded classes with `rounded-xl` and use flat borders rather than heavy shadows.
components_instructions.forms: Use customized Shadcn forms for registration/checkout. Inputs must have `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C9A961] focus:border-[#C9A961] bg-white`.
components_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react with strokeWidth={1.5} for a premium, delicate feel.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All cards should slightly lift `-translate-y-1` on hover. Buttons should smoothly shift background color.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Fade-in entrance animations for main content blocks.

merch_mockup.description: Minimalist mockups of wellness merchandise (journal, mug, tote)

workshop_community_1.description: A group of people sitting in a therapy/workshop circle

workshop_community_2.description: A diverse group of individuals engaging in a workshop setting

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Work Sans and Cormorant Garamond fonts from Google Fonts.
Implement the marketing pages using the Tetris Grid bento layouts. Avoid generic centered symmetric layouts.
The application acts as a hybrid platform: Marketing/Storefront features should feel editorial and premium, while the Dashboard/Participant features should feel calm, clear, and highly usable.
Ensure high contrast on text. No pure #000000; use the deep teal/gray (#1A2424) for primary text.
Implement test IDs (`data-testid`) on all interactive and informational elements.
